feeds.title: Mormon Momma
feeds.description: LDS women discuss church doctrine, policy, and practice as well as current events, life issues, children, families, and whatever else comes to mind.

feeds.title: C. Jane Kendrick
feeds.description: Proudly blogging in behalf of Bloggers With Lisps since 2005. C. Jane Kendrick is a writer, blogger, shape-shifter, columnist, Rooftop Concert Series co-founder, vlogger, wife, mother & advocate for fellow lispers.

feeds.title: Normal Mormon Family
feeds.description: I love the gospel of Jesus Christ, my family, my friends, taking a bazillion pictures of my kids, playing tennis, eating junk food, laughing, reading, singing, and playing the piano.

feeds.title: Mormon Mom Planner
feeds.description: If you are looking for a mom planner or mom agenda that is designed to be both cute and functional you have finally found what you are looking for. The mom planner includes both a monthly planner and a weekly planner. We offer the Mormon Mom Planner and the Mom-on-the-go planner, with the same great look and function but without the specific LDS elements.

feeds.title: Al Carraway
feeds.description: Al Carraway is an LDS convert, writer, multi-award-winning speaker, and author of the best-selling book, 'More Than the Tattooed Mormon,' and 'Cheers to Eternity!' Her passion is to tell everyone that happiness exists, and it comes from the gospel of Jesus Christ. That it's real. It is the greatest thing we could ever be a part of!

feeds.title: Tiffanie Rushton
feeds.description: I am Tiffanie Rushton. Mother of three. Wife of 28 years.. Special Education Teacher. I'm a bit of an obnoxious tourist, a fabulous baker, and a lover of dresses. This is a blog about my life's adventures.
